stages.reference: Create a close visual reference for the exposed side profile of podzol soil beneath an old coniferous forest in a grounded dark-fantasy climate. The face should reveal natural soil horizons rather than generic brown dirt: a dark organic upper layer rich in decomposed needles and roots, a subtly leached ash-gray transition, and deeper compact mineral earth stained muted brown and rusty by transported compounds. Fine roots cross and bind the layers irregularly. Avoid a clean textbook diagram, perfectly horizontal stripes, bright orange bands, rocks everywhere or cultivated soil. Make the layering emerge organically through centuries of acidic forest litter, rain and slow soil formation.
